labels: OWNER campaign approvals for the live PMUS spring probe. A campaign starts ONLY from an entry here whose campaign_id the durable campaign state has not run yet, after the previous campaign is complete and the continuation preflight (every filled market settled with venue-confirmed realized, zero open orders, positions flat) passes. Nothing here changes a per-market cap, the residual cap, concurrency, maker/post-only, the fee-safe completion rule, the deadman, the daily-loss stop or the frozen fidelity gate.

approvals.source: owner direction in chat after #167 comment 5559915772: 'continue Phase-1 evidence collection with a fresh R1 campaign after the current cs2 position has settled and the account is verified flat. This is an R1 evidence continuation, not R2 and not a risk-scale decision.'
approvals.stop_rule_reading: selection stops when the frozen gate reports every LIVE minimum met (live_scored_decisions >= 200, live_markets >= 5, live_post_fill_decisions >= 50, live_timed_intervals >= 50); not before 5 markets merely because 200 decisions arrived first; never manufactured. The daily-loss stop, per-market cap, residual cap, concurrency 1, maker/post-only, fee-safe completion and deadman are the existing R1 controls and bound the campaign.
preconditions: previous campaign complete: every filled market settled (venue POSITION_RESOLUTION) with realized_confirmed
zero open orders on the venue (orphan sweep sees none)
positions flat (venue positions show no market held)
clean preflight: no foreign open orders, no unresolved reconcile
approvals.not: not R2; not a risk-scale decision; campaigns_per_day for R1 is exceeded by this explicit owner approval only for the evidence continuation

approvals.source: #167 comment 5560851070: 'OWNER DECISION -- behavioral replication proof ACCEPTED. Advance to RUN. Build the smallest next rung that lets materially more of the already-proven L5 policy reach Polymarket ... Prefer changing spend cap + residual cap first ... Fresh rung/cohort/safety-shell label. Preserve R1 evidence immutable. Require account flat + zero open/foreign orders + prior campaign complete before first new first-leg ... No automatic promotion after this rung.'
approvals.rung_derivation: from the R1 cohort (203 clean decisions / 9 markets): 36/36 residual-cap forcings at exactly 3 units with L5's own draw EXTEND 61% at that point and 75% of L5's post-fill transitions above 5 units; 16 spend-cap forcings at $0.054-$0.112 filled notional; replay of the cohort's measured draw masses and fill rates: residual 6 removes ~92% of residual forcing (14.5% -> 1.2% of post-fill decisions), $0.15 clears every observed spend forcing; releasing both moves acted L1 0.54 -> ~0.05-0.08 and the acted post-fill gap 30 pp -> ~4-5 pp
approvals.stop_rule_reading: 6 filled markets, one at a time, each held to settlement; worst case 6 x $0.15 = $0.90 per campaign, bounded by the unchanged -$1.00 daily realized-loss stop (>= the worst case); campaigns_per_day 1; no automatic promotion afterwards -- the campaign ends at CAMPAIGN_RUNG_COMPLETE for the owner
approvals.unchanged: maker/post-only, fee-safe 0.98 completion bound, HOLD residual to settlement, concurrency 1, 6 actions per session, deadman/cancel, orphan sweep, settlement/realized accounting from the venue only, the frozen fidelity gate and its thresholds, the frozen L5 v2 policy and canonical lookup v3
preconditions: previous campaign R1-EVIDENCE-CONTINUATION-2026-09-06 complete: every filled market venue-settled
zero open orders on the venue (orphan sweep sees none), no foreign orders
positions flat (venue positions and availablePositions show no market held)
clean preflight: no unresolved reconcile; ledger holds no unsettled market
approvals.not: not a profitability optimization; not a size/bankroll guess; R1 rows keep their own shell label and are never re-scored under this rung
